title: Replace My Submissions with a dedicated Login page

requirements.summary: Remove the “My Submissions” header navigation entry while keeping all other existing nav items intact.
acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated or unauthenticated, the header no longer displays a “My Submissions” button/link.
No other existing nav items (Home, Articles, Admin, About, Contact) are removed or broken.

file_operations.description: Remove the conditional “My Submissions” navigation button/link and any now-unused imports (e.g., the User icon). Keep existing Home/Articles/Admin/About/Contact navigation behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated /login page that supports Internet Identity login and logout using the existing auth hook.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /login shows a login screen when the user is not authenticated, with a primary button that triggers Internet Identity login.
When the user is authenticated, /login shows the authenticated state (at minimum: a message indicating the user is logged in and a logout button).
All user-facing text on the login page is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a Login page that uses the existing Internet Identity hook for login/logout and displays authenticated vs unauthenticated states in English. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance to ensure logout clears cached application data (e.g., React Query cache). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register a new /login route that renders the new LoginPage, ensuring it is part of the router tree and navigable.

requirements.summary: Remove the MySubmissionsPage route and ensure /my-submissions shows the Login page experience instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /my-submissions no longer shows the My Submissions list UI.
Navigating to /my-submissions results in the Login page experience (equivalent to visiting /login).
The app builds successfully with no unused-import or route-tree errors related to removing MySubmissionsPage.

file_operations.description: Remove the MySubmissionsPage import and route configuration. Replace /my-submissions route behavior so it renders the same LoginPage experience (or otherwise forwards to /login) without exposing the old submissions UI.
Delete the MySubmissionsPage implementation to fully disable the /my-submissions experience and avoid unused code/imports after route removal.

requirements.summary: Update UI links that point to /my-submissions (notably the Submit Story success state) to point to /login with updated English text.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful story submission, the call-to-action that previously navigated to /my-submissions no longer points to /my-submissions.
The updated call-to-action navigates to /login and uses clear English text (e.g., “Login” or “Account”).

file_operations.description: Update the post-submit success call-to-action to navigate to /login instead of /my-submissions and change the button label to clear English (e.g., “Account” or “Login”). Also remove any now-unused imports that were only used for the old CTA.
